header_sentences: See Half an hour, and see Time.

contexts.text: Continued for the time of an hour or two hours.
Many hours then appear to him scarcely as one.
If he received faith at the last hour... AC 4925:2.
Of that day and hour knoweth no one () = the state of the Church then as to goods and truths, that it will not appear to anyone... Hour = the state in special.
Are there not twelve hours in the day? ()... Twelve hours = all states of truth. ( = states of life. AE 194:3.)
Would be saved even at the last hour...
The progression lasted two hours.
These changes lasted about ten hours. AC 10736.
Suppose thought to go on for ten or twelve hours...
Spirits let into these alternate states two or three times within an hour.
An hour, a day, a mouth, and a year () = continually and perpetually... AE 571.
In that hour () = then...
One hour () = for some time, and also somewhat.
In one hour () = so suddenly.
One hour () = suddenly and plainly.
In one hour they are devastated () = that on account of the destruction of that religiosity, after this no one can buy their holy things.
The worship of God (there) lasts about two hours.
They conversed for the half of an hour.
Thou knowest not what hour I shall come upon thee () = ignorance of that time and state then. Hour = the time when man will die, and also his state then.
The reason hour = state, is that all times in the Word... = the states of life... But as hour = both time and state...
These hours (), in the world, mean times, but in Heaven states of life; because in Heaven there are no hours...
Man does not remain such as he is at the hour of death.

An hour is often mentioned, and by it is signified duration greater or less... and when a number is added... there is signified the duration of the state; also the quality of the state according to the signification of the added number.
Three hours () = full and altogether.
Hour = state.
In that hour = while that state lasts.
Hour = some duration of state, less or greater; thus time and state.
The hour of His judgment has come... Hour = state; here, the last state of the Church.
The reason it is said the hour of judgment, is that hour = not only time, but also state...
The hour of reaping has come () = the time to do this.
By one hour (of Power with the beast) is signified some part; thus that they should reign somewhat with the harlot.

In one hour thy judgment has come... In one hour = suddenly; here, all; thus... total. Hour... = state... A number attached, by which is signified the successive duration of the time, = the quality of the state. Thus when it is said in one hour, there is signified all things suddenly...
This does not last more than a few hours...
To be devastated in one hour = total destruction...
Many were examined who in the last hours when they had received the eucharist had believed themselves to be saved by that faith...
